AdminBroadcastRequest.description:
Admin (platform) broadcast: the audience is the whole user base, segmentable
by account role and/or status. Behind auth:sanctum + role.admin.

subject.description: Subject is only meaningful for email; required when email is chosen.

AdminBroadcastRequest.title: AdminBroadcastRequest

CompleteOnboardingRequest.description:
Role-selection + completion for a freshly-provisioned SSO account.

Account identity (name/email/password) already exists from the SSO provision,
so only the role choice and its role-specific profile are accepted here.
CompleteOnboardingRequest.title: CompleteOnboardingRequest

member.description:
Flat member/workspace for the admin billing list (contract shape).
Present only when the subscription chain is eager-loaded.

subscription.description: Present only when the controller eager-loads the subscription chain.

MarkInvoicePaidRequest.description:
Validates the manual mark-paid action: an optional payment timestamp and an
optional payment receipt attached in the same step (pdf/jpg/png, max 5MB —
the same rules as a standalone receipt upload). Authorization is enforced by
the route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
MarkInvoicePaidRequest.title: MarkInvoicePaidRequest

OwnerBroadcastRequest.description:
Owner (workspace) broadcast: the audience is the owner's OWN members,
segmentable by subscription status. Behind auth:sanctum + role.owner; the
controller re-scopes every recipient to the owner's workspace.

subject.description: Subject is only meaningful for email; required when email is chosen.

OwnerBroadcastRequest.title: OwnerBroadcastRequest

StoreExpenseRequest.description:
Validates a new workspace expense submitted by the owner. Ownership is
enforced in the controller/service (the expense is attached to the owner's
own workspace), so no workspace_id is accepted from the client.
StoreExpenseRequest.title: StoreExpenseRequest

StoreResourceRequest.description:
Validates a new workspace resource submitted by the owner. The resource is
attached to the owner's own workspace server-side; no workspace_id is taken.
StoreResourceRequest.title: StoreResourceRequest

seat_types.description: Optional per-seat-type pricing submitted alongside the workspace.

TestMessagingRequest.description:
Validates the messaging test payload `{ channel: "email"|"sms", to }`.
For email, `to` must be a valid address; for SMS it is a free-form recipient
number. Authorization is handled by route middleware (auth:sanctum +
role.admin).
TestMessagingRequest.title: TestMessagingRequest

UpdateExpenseRequest.description:
Validates an edit to an existing workspace expense. Every field is optional
(`sometimes`) so the owner may patch a subset.
UpdateExpenseRequest.title: UpdateExpenseRequest

UpdateLandingRequest.description:
Validates the bilingual landing-page CMS payload. Every field is optional
(partial overrides) so any subset of the schema is accepted; the frontend
supplies i18n defaults for anything omitted. Authorization is handled by the
route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).

sections_order.description: --- Section order (admin-chosen order of the reorderable sections) ---

image.description:
Section image: stored media PATH (uploaded via POST .../images).
The resolved display URL (`imageUrl`) is added by the service on
read and accepted here so a round-tripped payload still validates.

UpdateLandingRequest.title: UpdateLandingRequest

UpdateMessagingSettingsRequest.description:
Validates the platform messaging payload `{ smtp?: {...}, sms?: {...} }`.
Every field is optional so partial updates work; secrets may be omitted or
sent blank to preserve the stored value. Authorization is handled by route
middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UpdateMessagingSettingsRequest.title: UpdateMessagingSettingsRequest

UpdatePasswordRequest.description:
Validates a self-service password change. The current password is verified in
the controller (against the stored hash); here we only enforce presence and
the new-password policy (min length + confirmation).
UpdatePasswordRequest.title: UpdatePasswordRequest

UpdateProfileRequest.description:
Validates a partial profile update for the authenticated user. Every field is
optional so the same endpoint serves admins (name/phone/avatar) and
freelancers (who additionally edit specialty/bio). Password changes go through
the dedicated UpdatePasswordRequest instead.
UpdateProfileRequest.title: UpdateProfileRequest

UpdateResourceRequest.description:
Validates an edit to an existing workspace resource. Every field is optional
(`sometimes`) so the owner may patch a subset.
UpdateResourceRequest.title: UpdateResourceRequest

UpdateSiteContentRequest.description:
Validates a site-wide CMS payload. The body is `{ "content": <blob> }` where
the blob is a free-form, bilingual, partial-override array whose shape varies
per content key (site / faq / about / how_it_works). The nested structure is
intentionally unconstrained — the frontend supplies i18n defaults for
anything omitted, so partial saves must pass. Authorization is handled by the
route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UpdateSiteContentRequest.title: UpdateSiteContentRequest

UpdateUserStatusRequest.description:
Validates an admin user-status transition. Authorization is enforced by the
route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UpdateUserStatusRequest.title: UpdateUserStatusRequest

UpdateWorkspaceMessagingRequest.description:
Validates a workspace owner's own messaging payload
`{ use_platform?: bool, smtp?: {...}, sms?: {...} }`. Same secret-blank rules
as the platform request: omit or blank a secret to keep the stored value.
Ownership is enforced via the 'manage-workspace' gate in the controller.
UpdateWorkspaceMessagingRequest.title: UpdateWorkspaceMessagingRequest

UploadLandingImageRequest.description:
Validates a single landing-section image upload. Authorization is handled by
the route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UploadLandingImageRequest.title: UploadLandingImageRequest

UploadReceiptRequest.description:
Validates a payment-receipt upload (pdf/jpg/png, max 5MB). Uploading a receipt
is the admin's proof of payment, so the invoice is marked paid by the handler;
an optional `paid_at` backdates that payment. Authorization is enforced by the
route middleware (auth:sanctum + role.admin).
UploadReceiptRequest.title: UploadReceiptRequest

seats_summary.description: Detail-only bundle: present when the controller attaches it.

owner.description: Admin listing only: present when the owner relation is loaded.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
